lastbroadcast.msg.key_locked: The console key switch is locked. Only the chief engineer has the key.
lastbroadcast.msg.fault_drive: The final amplifier screams as the drive drops with no coolant behind it. The overload relay trips and slams everything back to overdrive.
lastbroadcast.msg.fault_breaker: The plate breaker opens under load. A blue-white arc jumps the contacts. The overload relay trips and slams everything back to overdrive.
lastbroadcast.msg.fault_ground: Grounding a live antenna feed. The relay rack lights up like a flashbulb. The overload relay trips and slams everything back to overdrive.
lastbroadcast.msg.reel_recorded: This reel is already recorded. Insert a blank reel to record.
lastbroadcast.msg.bus_dead: Monitor bus is dead. Switch on a receiver near the deck.
lastbroadcast.msg.no_picture: Nothing but snow on channel %s. There is no picture to record.
lastbroadcast.msg.select_two: Select two different pieces of logged evidence.
lastbroadcast.msg.no_contradiction: These two agree with each other. Nothing here contradicts.
lastbroadcast.msg.no_stable: No stable picture to patch. Keep tuning.
lastbroadcast.msg.ghost_isolated: Ghost carrier isolated - patched to receivers as 7-B
lastbroadcast.msg.already_patched: 7-B is already patched through to the receivers.
lastbroadcast.msg.protected: This is an active FCC investigation site. Leave the equipment as you found it.
lastbroadcast.msg.reel_threaded: A reel is already threaded. Sneak-use the deck to eject it.
lastbroadcast.msg.no_reel: No reel threaded. Use a reel of magnetic tape on the deck.
lastbroadcast.msg.locker_empty: Spare tubes, a slide rule, a thermos. You already took the log.
lastbroadcast.msg.take_tape: You take two reels of blank Valley Magnetics tape from the stock shelf.
lastbroadcast.msg.cabinet_empty: Carbon copies, coffee rings and old rate cards. Nothing useful.
lastbroadcast.msg.shelf_empty: Boxes of recorded programmes, all labelled and dated. Nothing out of place.
lastbroadcast.msg.notice_empty: Shift rosters and a bowling league flyer.
lastbroadcast.msg.intro1: Halloway Falls, Ohio - Tuesday, October 23, 1962 - 11:40 PM
lastbroadcast.msg.intro2: Your assignment letter is in your coat pocket. Report to Master Control.

lastbroadcast.msg.meter_pinned: (pinned - you are on top of it)
lastbroadcast.msg.meter_quiet: Field strength 44 dBuV - normal background. The carrier is quiet.

lastbroadcast.lead.closed: Case closed. Channel 7-B is dead carrier. File the report.
lastbroadcast.lead.placard: The placard is wrong and the log says why. Shut the Skyhook down - in the right order.
lastbroadcast.lead.frame: One frame of the bulletin shows the console mid-disaster. Compare it with what is posted on the wall.
lastbroadcast.lead.arc: The shutdown went wrong exactly as the bulletin warned. Something in the procedure must be wrong.
lastbroadcast.lead.console: Penrose gave you the console. Before you touch it, study the bulletin on tape - frame by frame if you must.
lastbroadcast.lead.d3: 7-B has a new programme. Record it. Then talk to Penrose - he can't hide behind the log now.
lastbroadcast.lead.locker: Penrose's transmitter log is in your hands. Set it against the dates in Rosa's complaint log.
lastbroadcast.lead.reel: Penrose's reel sounds wrong. Try every way the deck can play it.
lastbroadcast.lead.d2: WKVR means to break its licence. Ask Rosa who runs the transmitter at night.
lastbroadcast.lead.d1: 7-B is showing programmes that haven't been made yet. Keep watching - and keep recording.
lastbroadcast.lead.signal: Watch Channel 7-B. Record what you see and set it against the station's own records.
lastbroadcast.lead.met_rosa: Use the signal analyzer in Master Control to dig the ghost carrier out from under Channel 7.
lastbroadcast.lead.start: Report to the night operator in Master Control (east down the corridor, first door on the right).

lastbroadcast.ui.ending.r2: Field Engineering & Monitoring Bureau - Detroit District
lastbroadcast.ui.ending.r5: Licensee was operating the Skyhook array at approx. four times authorized visual power on Tuesday nights since 18 September. Interference reports coincide with every unauthorized run.
lastbroadcast.ui.ending.r6: Overdrive equipment was shut down by this engineer and the chief engineer and is now disconnected. The posted emergency shutdown procedure was found to be out of date and has been withdrawn. The demonstration scheduled for 25 October is cancelled.
lastbroadcast.ui.ending.r7: Nature of the received interference: see attached annex, which this engineer does not expect anyone to believe.
